Body.Content: We're reducing prices by up to 20% for Block Blobs Storage and Disks/Page Blobs Storage, up to 28% for Locally Redundant Disks/Page Blobs Storage, and reducing the price of Azure Storage transactions by 50%. These pricing reductions are in effect for all regions worldwide. Learn more on the Azure Storage pricing page.
Body.Markdown:
We're reducing prices by up to 20% for Block Blobs Storage and Disks/Page Blobs Storage, up to 28% for Locally Redundant Disks/Page Blobs Storage, and reducing the price of Azure Storage transactions by 50%. These pricing reductions are in effect for all regions worldwide.

Learn more on the Azure Storage pricing page .
